name: home-assistant-admin
description: Home Assistant WebSocket API: sign-in only, no message is blocked.
card_text: Home Assistant, UNRESTRICTED: nothing the client sends is filtered, including commands that create long-lived tokens, manage users or run shell commands.
risk_notes: No deny list, no allow list, no rules: the client can do anything the signed-in user can do.
Anything it creates (for example a long-lived access token) outlives the session and is not masked or revoked with it.
Use only for a short, supervised session that needs these commands.
